answer: At a fixed time each epoch, give every earning key a different, unpredictable test with a 60-second deadline. Require 100 verified labels per test: an atlas coordinate, a raven image, or a spiral orientation are examples. Bind each test to its key and epoch so answers cannot be recycled. An attacker running 1,000 clones must complete 100,000 fresh labels in the same minute, buying extra inference capacity and bandwidth; merely inventing names supplies neither.
